message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Five high-confidence vulnerabilities directly matching monitored products were published in the 24-hour window ending 2026-08-01 05:10 IST. Two pgAdmin 4 issues are Critical and warrant immediate review. Twenty-one additional CVEs affect third-party WordPress plugins; installation status is unknown, so they are listed separately for inventory review.

Coverage note: the public CVE List and linked primary advisories were checked. General web search was unavailable during this run, so vendor notices not yet represented in the CVE feed may be missing.

### Confirmed product matches

**Finding 1**
- Product: pgAdmin 4
- Issue: CVE-2026-17566
- Severity: Critical (CVSS 9.9)
- Description: An incomplete query guard can allow remote code execution through an import/export backslash-escape mismatch.
- Relevance: The CVE explicitly identifies pgAdmin 4, which is monitored.
- Source: [pgAdmin issue](https://github.com/pgadmin-org/pgadmin4/issues/10213)

**Finding 2**
- Product: pgAdmin 4
- Issue: CVE-2026-17349
- Severity: Critical (CVSS 9.6)
- Description: Cloning an ad hoc server can expose another user's stored database credentials and transfer ownership to a non-owner.
- Relevance: The CVE explicitly identifies pgAdmin 4, which is monitored.
- Source: [pgAdmin issue](https://github.com/pgadmin-org/pgadmin4/issues/10200)

**Finding 3**
- Product: pgAdmin 4
- Issue: CVE-2026-17348
- Severity: Medium (CVSS 6.5)
- Description: Missing authentication decorators allow unauthenticated access to several routes when pgAdmin runs in server mode.
- Relevance: The CVE explicitly identifies pgAdmin 4, which is monitored.
- Source: [pgAdmin issue](https://github.com/pgadmin-org/pgadmin4/issues/10194)

**Finding 4**
- Product: Hikvision wireless AP and gateway products
- Issue: CVE-2026-16843
- Severity: High (CVSS 7.2)
- Description: A command-execution vulnerability affects multiple Hikvision DS-3WAP and DS-3WG models.
- Relevance: Hikvision is monitored; confirm whether any affected models are deployed.
- Source: [Hikvision advisory](https://www.hikvision.com/en/support/cybersecurity/security-advisory/command-execution-vulnerability-in-some-wireless-ap-products/)

**Finding 5**
- Product: Node.js 22.x, 24.x, and 26.x
- Issue: CVE-2026-58039
- Severity: Low (CVSS 3.3)
- Description: Permission Model enforcement allows process.report to write or overwrite files outside paths authorized by --allow-fs-write.
- Relevance: The CVE explicitly identifies Node.js, which is monitored.
- Source: [Node.js vulnerability page](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/vulnerability)

### Possible matches needing review

The following newly published CVEs affect third-party WordPress plugins. They are relevant only where the named plugin is installed; none of the records below identifies WordPress core, Yoast SEO, or Advanced Custom Fields as affected.

- **CVE-2026-14830 — FlxWoo < 3.1.1 — High (7.5):** unauthenticated payment bypass. [WPScan](https://wpscan.com/vulnerability/b866258c-b49b-40db-a0ff-6c0921b5c89f/)
- **CVE-2026-12695 — miniOrange 2FA < 6.2.6 — High (8.1):** attacker-controlled secret can bypass two-factor authentication. [WPScan](https://wpscan.com/vulnerability/1994ce51-3534-4cb3-b424-d2f9014e8bb3/)
- **CVE-2026-15048 — GeekyBot < 1.2.8 — High (7.5):** unauthenticated exposure of chat history. [WPScan](https://wpscan.com/vulnerability/881d1548-e6c3-4093-ab8c-dc3a9fcccc34/)
- **CVE-2026-14333 — Demi < 0.0.7 — High (7.5):** public backup directory exposes sensitive data without authentication. [WPScan](https://wpscan.com/vulnerability/df673b6f-2957-460a-b6fe-6e656d9193e0/)
- **CVE-2026-14319 — GiveWP < 4.16.3 — High (7.5):** unauthenticated recurring-donor information disclosure. [WPScan](https://wpscan.com/vulnerability/f90c88a8-e5a5-4bcf-8fa1-59cdfef015a4/)
- **CVE-2026-12721 — Kirki < 6.0.13 — High (8.6):** unauthenticated SQL injection. [WPScan](https://wpscan.com/vulnerability/4cba3900-9f29-4928-811c-163827358052/)
- **CVE-2026-14930 — JS Help Desk < 3.1.4 — High (7.5):** unauthenticated arbitrary ticket-attachment upload. [WPScan](https://wpscan.com/vulnerability/075ca843-e787-43cc-8de4-54d8ddc63d4a/)
- **CVE-2026-8155 — BuddyPress < 14.5.0 — Medium (5.4):** authenticated subscribers can read, modify, or delete other users' private messages. [WPScan](https://wpscan.com/vulnerability/b7dd9cbf-b46b-49ee-84a0-6b054676fccb/)
- **CVE-2026-14843 — Events Made Easy < 3.1.4 — Medium (5.3):** unauthenticated modification of person data through an IDOR. [WPScan](https://wpscan.com/vulnerability/0b445129-19e2-4240-a79a-d3190161d369/)
- **CVE-2026-14921 — Ultimate Addons for WPBakery Page Builder < 3.21.5 — Medium (6.1):** contributor-level stored cross-site scripting. [WPScan](https://wpscan.com/vulnerability/4bebd9ff-87b6-45ca-9b3e-9e6048693ca6/)
- **CVE-2026-18436 — MailerPress <= 1.5.0 — Medium (5.3):** an unauthenticated REST endpoint permits unauthorized modification. [Wordfence](https://www.wordfence.com/threat-intel/vulnerabilities/id/793a7ef0-8938-47a6-80ed-83f69fbbb27f?source=cve)
- **CVE-2026-15209 — JS Help Desk < 3.1.5 — Medium (6.5):** authenticated subscribers can view other users' support tickets. [WPScan](https://wpscan.com/vulnerability/3665b8dd-2b02-4c3b-b024-f1e07f934fab/)
- **CVE-2026-12376 — Academy LMS <= 3.8.2 — Medium (4.3):** authenticated subscribers can access sensitive quiz-attempt information. [WPScan](https://wpscan.com/vulnerability/8cdd6ab6-d523-4406-a0ef-d9b3b27e10c8/)
- **CVE-2026-14834 — Mailgun for WordPress < 2.2.1 — Medium (6.5):** unauthenticated requests can add addresses to Mailgun lists. [WPScan](https://wpscan.com/vulnerability/84135fff-e602-4773-8e79-a831284de0d2/)
- **CVE-2026-28145 — MasterStudy LMS <= 3.7.39 — Medium (5.3):** insufficient verification enables manipulation of user state. [Patchstack](https://patchstack.com/database/wordpress/plugin/masterstudy-lms-learning-management-system/vulnerability/wordpress-masterstudy-lms-plugin-3-7-39-broken-access-control-vulnerability?_s_id=cve)
- **CVE-2026-54768 — WPGraphQL — Medium (6.9):** a deprecated password-reset response field can expose user existence and profile data. [GitHub advisory](https://github.com/wp-graphql/wp-graphql/security/advisories/GHSA-jhh7-832h-f8hv)
- **CVE-2026-12697 — wpForo Forum < 3.1.2 — Medium (5.4):** authenticated subscribers can delete other users' AI chat messages. [WPScan](https://wpscan.com/vulnerability/845362bb-a733-432e-86ac-7bf079d91e0f/)
- **CVE-2026-14833 — Lightbox with PhotoSwipe < 5.9.0 — Medium (6.8):** author-level stored cross-site scripting through a caption attribute. [WPScan](https://wpscan.com/vulnerability/aae59cb8-b259-464e-a86b-164d89f61342/)
- **CVE-2026-14931 — JS Help Desk < 3.1.4 — Medium (6.5):** contributor-level disclosure of user email addresses. [WPScan](https://wpscan.com/vulnerability/852375ba-b8f5-4fef-8a37-d889d97227f0/)
- **CVE-2026-13393 — ElementsKit Lite < 3.10.01 — Low (3.5):** stored cross-site scripting by a subsite administrator in multisite deployments. [WPScan](https://wpscan.com/vulnerability/e1eddc5a-cc5a-4665-a5c8-fcdf121be241/)
- **CVE-2026-14862 — Support Genix Lite < 1.4.48 — Low (3.7):** missing authorization permits ticket-attachment downloads. [WPScan](https://wpscan.com/vulnerability/ef1c6fd5-e62c-4951-a0ba-0e61edb1e795/)

Immediate review is recommended for pgAdmin 4 because of the two Critical findings, followed by checking Hikvision model inventory and the installed WordPress plugin list. The Node.js issue is lower priority based on the reported severity but should be assessed where the Permission Model is relied upon as a security boundary.
